text:
Hallie: Quick ask — can someone run a CB scaling probe on staging (g4dn-xlarge) using model bert-qlora? Need sweep over window-ms 12/25/50 and max_batch 8/16/32. Want p95/p99 + tokens/sec and avg batch size. Trying to validate the new prefetch optimization before we flip it in prod. Target: today if possible.

Omar: I can take the 12/25/50 sweep on pool-staging-3. Which loadgen binary? loadgen-v2 or the old one?

Hallie: Use loadgen/v2/run_sweep.sh. Main args: --model bert-qlora --batch-sizes 8,16,32 --max-tokens 4096 --window-ms 12,25,50 --duration 5m --warmup 60s --kv-cache=enabled. Also run each config twice for stability.

Ryan: FYI PR #1242 touches the cb heuristics (prefetch). If you're testing prefetch, please run both PR off and PR on. Might explain tail differences.

Maya: I'll coordinate stateful runs and collect traces. Omar, ping me when you start so I can attach the profiler.

Omar: Starting run now on staging-3. Kicking loadgen with the args Hallie posted. Command:
```
./loadgen/v2/run_sweep.sh \
  --model bert-qlora \
  --batch-sizes 8,16,32 \
  --max-tokens 4096 \
  --window-ms 12,25,50 \
  --duration 300 \
  --warmup 60 \
  --kv-cache enabled \
  --repeat 2
```

bench-bot: Run started — job id cb-sweep-1968432100-1 — logs at https://internal/bench/cb-sweep-1968432100-1

Maya: Run finished for window 12ms (PR off): p95=48ms, p99=152ms, tokens/sec=23.1k, avg_batch=10, max_batch_observed=28. No OOMs. Attached minimal flamegraph.

Omar: 25ms window (PR off): p95=60ms, p99=210ms, tokens/sec=25.6k, avg_batch=14.

Hallie: Interesting — 25ms giving higher tokens/sec than 12ms. Any skew from long sequences or warmup effects?

Ryan: Sequence distribution for this workload: median seq=211, p90=880, p95=1200. 25ms window seems to hit a sweet spot for merging requests. I'll pull per-token distribution and KV-cache hit rates.

Omar: 50ms window (PR off): p95=95ms, p99~320ms, tokens/sec=26.9k, avg_batch=19. Tail worsened though.

Maya: Now re-running with PR #1242 enabled (prefetch). 12ms window (PR on): p95=40ms, p99=138ms, tokens/sec=24.5k — ~6% p95 improvement vs off. avg_batch up slightly.

Hallie: Good signal. Can someone upload the raw traces + flamegraphs to the bench job and drop links here? Also add a short note in the PR about the p99 regression at 50ms. We need to decide whether to flip prefetch by default or gate it behind config.

Ryan: Uploaded traces & flamegraphs to https://internal/bench/cb-sweep-1968432100-1/traces and left comments on PR #1242. Quick look: KV-cache miss spikes during warmup correlate with p99 spikes; prefetch reduces those misses.

ci-bot: smoke tests passed for cb-sweep-1968432100-1 (no functional regressions detected).

Maya: Suggested next steps:
- Omar to schedule a nightly full-sweep across models (bert-qlora, llama-mini, redwood-3b-quant) with prefetch on/off.
- Ryan to add auto-plot script that produces p95/p99 + tokens/sec per-window and uploads to bench.
- Hallie to draft a short release note and rollback criteria.

Omar: Will schedule the full sweep tomorrow 02:00 UTC and attach job ids. Assigning to myself.

Hallie: Thanks all — great quick turnaround :tada:. I'll track follow-ups in the cb-tuning project board and put a link to the PR + bench results.

Maya: Also, small QA note — when you run the full-sweep, include a run with --kv-cache=disabled so we can quantify cache impact.

Omar: Good call. Adding that to the sweep matrix.

Hallie: Perfect. Closing thread but leaving action items in the board.
